purpose: Append-only source-contract repair and response-blind GW150914 H1/L1 development test of the six v2 dynamic-source-memory kernels, with all equivalences, failures, and ordinary countermodels retained.

sources.dq_mapping: DQ element j governs [gps_start+j,gps_start+j+1); require the DATA bit (bit 0) at every second intersecting the analysis interval; never treat DQ as a 4096-Hz array
sources.response_access_rule: Freeze intent first; download opaque bytes and freeze both payload hashes second; only then inspect HDF schema or DQ; read strain only after schema and injection gates pass.

analysis.detrend: mean subtraction then scipy.signal.detrend(type=linear), separately for every detector and interval

psd.average: median within each side then arithmetic mean of sides

analysis.template_anchor: NR coalescence t=0 is placed at event_gps; kernel time uses s=t/T_star; no response-dependent normalization or parameter
analysis.source_normalization: divide the frozen NR strain column by its pre-response max absolute value; K05 threshold therefore remains exactly 0.25
analysis.likelihood: profiled relative frequency-domain Whittle Gaussian with one analytic complex amplitude per detector
analysis.selection: maximum over the exact frozen common-time and L1-minus-H1 delay grids; no retuning
analysis.trials: seven kernel templates plus five explicit countermodels are all reported; development-only delta-2logL and no sigma conversion

injections.noise_model: independent unit-variance complex Gaussian frequency bins on the frozen 20-512 Hz grid; same profiled Whittle objective and exact nuisance grids
injections.pass_rule: zero noncausal early-response detections and at least 90 percent equivalence-family recovery at network SNR 20; retain every cell and tie

countermodels.definition: K02; ordinary one-pole source or instrument response
K03; ordinary two-pole source or instrument response
K00 source plus causal damped sinusoid beginning 0.06 s after coalescence, decay 0.012 s, angular frequency 700 rad/s, amplitude 0.65 times source maximum
K02 conditional mean; coherent-source excess variance must beat independent detector noise
repeat scores with each one-sided PSD and their arithmetic mean
predeclared diagnostic amplitude tilt plus phase tilt over 20-512 Hz; because exact published frequency-dependent calibration envelopes are absent, this cannot validate an empirical claim

claim_ceiling.reason: one event, NR source nuisance, explicit ordinary response/source countermodels, trials, and missing exact frequency-dependent calibration uncertainty artifacts
claim_ceiling.required_next: unchanged multi-event transfer with exact calibration uncertainty products and source-waveform marginalization
